pain_points.statement: Finance is significantly delayed on invoicing due to data discrepancies.
pain_points.source_excerpt: finance is 3 weeks behind on invoicing because the data never lines up.

desired_state.statement: The client wants a fixed-fee engagement with milestone-based payments.
desired_state.source_excerpt: fixed-fee proposal with milestone payments tied to specific outcomes

success_criteria.statement: The project should free up $1.4M in working capital by improving DSO.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: frees up about $1.4M in working capital that's currently stuck in unbilled receivables.

success_criteria.statement: Reduce dispatch time to avoid hiring four additional dispatchers, saving $320k.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: we don't need to hire four additional dispatchers next year, which is about $320k

risks_unknowns.statement: There is disagreement on the approved budget for the Phase 1 engagement.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: I approved a six-month engagement up to $300k.
risks_unknowns.contradiction_note: Rita states the cap is $300k, while Sarah claims they discussed a $250k to $400k range.

pain_points.statement: The custom dispatch tool is old and has severe technical debt.
pain_points.source_excerpt: We can't ship features anymore because the codebase is too fragile.

pain_points.statement: Drivers are highly dissatisfied with the current mobile app.

desired_state.statement: There is disagreement on whether to fix the current workflows or replace the entire platform.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Sarah thinks this is a workflow problem. I think this is a platform problem.
desired_state.contradiction_note: Sarah wants to fix workflows incrementally, while Marcus wants to replace Routemaster entirely with a SaaS platform.

success_criteria.statement: A majority of the Phase 1 workflow logic should survive a future platform change.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: I'd estimate 60-70% of the Phase 1 work survives a platform change.

risks_unknowns.statement: Previous internal attempts to fix the workflow issues have failed.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: We've tried internal projects to fix this exact thing twice and they both failed.

pain_points.statement: Dispatchers suffer from excessive manual double-entry between systems.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Too much manual entry between our custom dispatch tool and Salesforce

desired_state.statement: Resolve the upstream dispatcher workflow to fix downstream invoicing data.
desired_state.source_excerpt: dispatcher workflow because it's the upstream cause of the bad invoicing data.

success_criteria.statement: Achieve a 30% reduction in dispatch time per load.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: a 30% reduction in dispatch time per load

risks_unknowns.statement: Changes to the driver app must coordinate with the upcoming ELD compliance mandate.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: if we touch the driver app at all in Phase 2, we need to do it in a way that supports ELD.

pain_points.statement: Technology integration from recent company acquisitions remains unfinished.
pain_points.source_excerpt: Tech integration from those acquisitions is incomplete.

desired_state.statement: There is disagreement on the timeline for delivering the pilot.
desired_state.source_excerpt: Q3 was your commitment, not mine. I never agreed to Q3.
desired_state.contradiction_note: Sarah and Rita require a Q3 pilot for budget reasons, but Marcus believes Q4 is more realistic.

success_criteria.statement: A pilot must be in production by the end of September to secure funding.
success_criteria.source_excerpt: If we don't have something in production by end of September, the funding gets reallocated.

risks_unknowns.statement: Missing the November ELD compliance deadline could result in losing operating authority.
risks_unknowns.source_excerpt: Fines, possibly losing our operating authority in some states.
